description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 29.02.2016 to 06.03.2016
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and concerns the determination of official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges. It is a regulatory instrument that establishes legally binding rates for financial transactions related to customs, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette. The notification is issued by a government official but does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would fall under Types 1-3.
